definition: Women’s health, fertility, maternity, menopause, hormonal health, pediatrics, and family-building/family-benefits care.
example_companies: Maven Clinic; Midi Health; Pomelo Care; Allara; Oula; Tia
assignment_rule: Use when the core market is women’s/reproductive/family care even if product model is virtual care, benefits, or marketplace.

definition: Obesity, GLP-1/weight management, diabetes, cardiometabolic care, metabolic behavior change, CGM-led metabolic coaching, nutrition care, and food-as-medicine.
example_companies: Noom Med; ZOE; Levels; Foodsmart; Fay; Omada; 9amHealth
assignment_rule: Use for nutrition, obesity, diabetes, and metabolic behavior companies. Distinctions move to subsegment tags.

definition: Therapy, psychiatry, behavioral health access, substance-use treatment, eating-disorder care, and related care models.
example_companies: Rula; Headway; Grow Therapy; Equip; Affect; Boulder Care
assignment_rule: Use for mental/behavioral health even when the model is marketplace or provider network.

definition: Specialty-condition care that is not women/family, metabolic/nutrition, or mental/behavioral: GI, MSK, oncology, kidney, cardiovascular, dermatology, neurology, autoimmune, respiratory, etc.
example_companies: Oshi Health; Cylinder Health; Sword Health; Hinge Health; Thyme Care; Strive Health
assignment_rule: Use for condition-specific specialty care. Nuance goes into condition subsegment tags.

definition: Primary care, urgent care, longitudinal virtual/hybrid care, full-stack digital clinic, or broad front-door care that is not primarily a specialty category.
example_companies: K Health; Carbon Health; Galileo; Firefly Health; One Medical
assignment_rule: Use when the core proposition is the care front door or longitudinal primary care, not a narrow condition.

definition: Senior care, aging-in-place, caregiver support, home care, home health, hospital-at-home, PACE enablement, and eldercare-focused platforms.
example_companies: Cera; Honor; Papa; IntusCare; Medically Home
assignment_rule: Use when the core market is seniors/caregivers/home-based care.

definition: Consumer-oriented preventive wellness, longevity, sleep, fitness, recovery, and self-directed health optimization. This includes consumer lab/biomarker, screening, wearable, and app-based products when the core market problem is consumer health optimization rather than clinical treatment advancement.
example_companies: Function Health; InsideTracker; Neko Health; Oura; Eight Sleep; Whoop; Ultrahuman; Future
assignment_rule: Use when the company is primarily helping consumers understand, monitor, or optimize health, longevity, sleep, fitness, recovery, or preventive wellness. Data inputs may include labs, biomarkers, imaging, wearables, or self-logged behavior.

definition: Care matching, care navigation, patient advocacy, benefits navigation, care concierge, and helping users access/coordinate care as the core market.
example_companies: Solace; Included Health; Transcarent; Accolade; Rightway
assignment_rule: Use when navigation/access is the actual market, not merely a feature within a specialty program.

definition: Health insurance, employer benefits platforms, payer enablement, value-based care infrastructure, risk/population management, and Medicaid/VBC infrastructure.
example_companies: Angle Health; Collective Health; Cityblock; Waymark; Strive Health when payer/VBC is primary
assignment_rule: Use when the company primarily sells infrastructure, benefits, or risk/VBC models rather than a condition-specific care product.

definition: Provider-facing AI, clinical intelligence, documentation, scribing, prior authorization, coding, RCM, workflow automation, and provider admin infrastructure.
example_companies: OpenEvidence; Abridge; Ambience; Nabla; Akasa; Cedar for provider revenue workflow
assignment_rule: Use when the buyer/user is the provider enterprise or clinician workflow, not a patient condition.

definition: Clinical diagnostics, clinical trials, real-world evidence, pharma/life sciences, drug discovery, and medicine/treatment advancement. Excludes consumer preventive wellness and longevity companies whose buyer/user problem is consumer health optimization.
example_companies: Tempus; Komodo Health; Qure.ai; Viz.ai; Freenome; Grail; PathAI; TrialSpark-style companies
assignment_rule: Use when the company primarily serves clinical medicine advancement, pharma/life sciences, clinical trial operations, RWE, drug development, or clinical diagnostic decision-making. Do not use merely because a consumer product uses labs, biomarkers, or imaging.

definition: Temporary value only when a company cannot be mapped into an approved top-level segment.
assignment_rule: Should block dashboard export. Do not leave active companies here.
